messages:
Mara: FYI CI perf alert on PR #8742 — microbench kv_cache_hitrate shows a big regression, end-to-end median latency +11% vs baseline.
ci-bot: [perf-check] job=microbench/kv_cache_hitrate status=failed threshold_diff=+11.2% url=http://ci/reports/2170000042
Alex: Ugh. Which commit in the PR landed the batching change?
Mara: The PR made a small heuristic tweak in kernel selection: prefer dense kernels when kv_miss_ratio > 0.15 — commit abc1234.
Jing: I ran the local microbench with perf enabled. KV hit_rate dropped from ~0.62 -> ~0.19 on our short-seq workload. Looks like prefix caching not being used for many traces.
Naomi: Can you paste the kernel selector logs?
Jing: Sure — snippet:```kernel_selector: evaluate candidates: [matmul_sparse_v1, matmul_dense_v2]
heuristic: kv_miss_ratio=0.22 -> prefer_dense=true
chosen: matmul_dense_v2 (est_cost=9.8)
kv_cache: hits=112 misses=464 hit_rate=0.194
workload: median_seq=64, prefix_repeat=0.02```
Tom: If we're choosing dense kernels for sequences with poor KV hit rates that seems wrong — dense kernels are more compute-heavy when kv caching would help because of repeated prefixes.
Alex: Agree. The heuristic in abc1234 used a too-low threshold and didn't consider prefix_repeat. In some short-chat workloads prefix_repeat is the main signal.
Sree: Bisecting quickly: reverted abc1234 locally and microbench returns to baseline within noise. So abc1234 is the likely culprit.
Mara: Thanks. Tom, can you open a revert PR for abc1234 (hotfix) and mark it as rollout-blocker? We should also add a test to cover prefix_repeat influence.
Tom: On it. I'll submit revert PR 8752 in ~10m.
Jing: I can add a microbench variant that forces low kv hit rate but high prefix_repeat to catch this class. Also adding a small unit test for kernel_selector with synthetic stats.
Naomi: On monitoring side, I'll add a short-term alert to fail the rollout if microbench median latency regresses >5% on the golden workload.
Alex: Long term fix: kernel selector should combine kv_miss_ratio and prefix_repeat into a single score, not a single threshold. I'll sketch a patch to score = alpha*kv_miss + beta*(1 - prefix_repeat) and tune params.
Sree: CI note: the perf CI uses the non-debug build. Re-run after revert and the added microbench should guard against regressions.
ci-bot: [action] opened_issue=PR-8752 revert abc1234 author=tom url=http://ci/pr/8752
Tom: PR 8752 opened and flagged as emergency revert. Linking this thread in the PR description.
Mara: Thanks everyone. Priority: revert merged -> re-run perf CI -> merge microbench + unit test -> follow-up scoring fix.
Alex: Assigning: Jing (microbench + unit test), Alex (scoring PR draft), Tom (revert PR), Naomi (monitoring), Sree (verify CI runs).
Mara: If revert merges we should hold downstream canary. Sree can coordinate.
Sree: Will watch the canary and post updates.
Naomi: Posted the temporary alert and webhook to slack: #eng-runtime.
Mara: :thumbsup: keeping this thread updated with CI links and any odd findings.
Jing: Running the local perf runs with debug knobs now — uploading flamegraphs to the CI url when ready.```
